source.label: th:hypercube
source.quote: Then {\sc osmd} on $\cA$ with regularizer~(\ref{eq:entro-reg}) satisfies, for any $\eta$ and $\gamma \in (0,1)$ such that $\frac{\eta d}{\gamma} \leq \frac12$, ... results.notes: Intermediate bound (eq. hypercuberegret1) involves algorithm-dependent expectations; not recorded separately. Computational complexity linear in d per paper. gamma in (0,1) implicitly requires n large relative to d^2.

source.label: th:ball
source.quote: Then {\sc osmd} on $\cA' = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\| \leq 1-\gamma \}$ with the estimate \eqref{eq:ballestimate}, and $F(x) = - \log (1 - \|x\|) - \|x\|$ satisfies, for any $\eta$ such that $\eta d \leq \frac12$, ... In particular, with $\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$ and $\eta= \sqrt{\frac{\log n}{2 n d}}$, $R_n \leq  3 \sqrt{d n \log n}$.

results.notes: Intermediate bound (eq. ballregret1) involves algorithm-dependent expectations; not recorded separately.
